info.description: All site pages — Home, Classes, Coaches, Schedule, Programs, Pricing, Gallery, Contact, etc. Add sections to build each page's layout. The slug field is the URL path (e.g. 'home', 'classes', 'contact').

content-manager.label: Title
content-manager.description: The display title shown on the page and in browser tabs.

content-manager.label: URL Slug
content-manager.description: URL path segment, auto-generated from the title. E.g. "our-classes" → /our-classes.

content-manager.label: Page Sections
content-manager.description: Build the page layout by adding and reordering sections. Each section type creates a different visual block.

content-manager.label: SEO Settings
content-manager.description: Search engine optimisation settings for this page.
